name: search_movies
description: Retrieves movies matching multiple conditions including keywords, actors, genres, ratings, and emotions. Returns a list of movie dictionaries with details like title, release year, rating, genres, cast, and similar movies.

keyword.description: List of keywords related to movie content (e.g., ['space exploration','war,heart-warming','3D','alien','mind and soul'])It is recommended that you fill in multiple keywords covering different aspects to ensure search accuracy.

actors.description: List of actor names to include (e.g., ['Leonardo DiCaprio', 'Jennifer Lawrence'])

genres.description: List of movie genres (e.g., ['action', 'comedy'], supports aliases like 'sci-fi' for 'science fiction')

include_adult.description: Whether to include adult content (default: false)
